hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Ghana and Liberia || mostly flat to undulating plains; mountains in northwest || most of the inhabitants live along the sandy coastal region; apart from the capital area, the forested interior is sparsely populated || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, diamonds, manganese, iron ore, cobalt, bauxite, copper, gold, nickel, tantalum, silica sand, clay, cocoa beans, coffee, palm oil, hydropower || Exports: gold, cocoa beans, rubber, refined petroleum, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat to undulating plains; mountains in northwest || Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Ghana and Liberia

climate.excerpt: tropical along coast, semiarid in far north; three seasons - warm and dry (November to March), hot and dry (March to May), hot and wet (June to October) || coast has heavy surf and no natural harbors; during the rainy season torrential flooding is possible

economy.excerpt: one of West Africa’s most influential, stable, and rapidly developing economies; poverty declines in urban but increases in rural areas; strong construction sector and increasingly diverse economic portfolio; increasing but manageable public debt; large labor force in agriculture || Exports: gold, cocoa beans, rubber, refined petroleum, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews (2023) || Industries: foodstuffs, beverages; wood products, oil refining, gold mining, truck and bus assembly, textiles, fertilizer, building materials, electricity
